name: The Stolen Tome
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Drusilla La Salle seeks a stolen tome from the Defias camp in the vineyards. Powers of the Void could aid her teaching, and bringing it back will prove your skill.

sections.title: A Forbidden Opportunity
sections.body: Warlocks in Stormwind's lands keep their craft and their research from prying eyes. Northshire Abbey guards forbidden grimoires in its archives. Drusilla cannot risk suspicion from the clerics and paladins by entering the protected wing herself. She covets Powers of the Void and needs another to retrieve it.

sections.title: Defias Opportunism
sections.body: An abbey novice joined the Defias Brotherhood and stole several valuable texts as he left. He fled to the Northshire Vineyards and took refuge near the Defias campsite. The thieves keep their prize in a field tent, unaware of the danger in the book's dark arts.

sections.title: The First Binding
sections.body: Recovering Powers of the Void tests your nerve and opens the way to darker knowledge. Returning the tome satisfies Drusilla's ambition and proves you are ready to practice the dark arts. She rewards you with the rites to summon and bind an imp, the first demon an apprentice learns to command.

faq.q: What is the Powers of the Void?
faq.answer: Powers of the Void is a forbidden grimoire about dark magic and control of the planes. The guarded wing of Northshire Abbey's library holds knowledge Drusilla La Salle covets for her study and teachings.

faq.q: Why didn't Drusilla La Salle steal the book herself?
faq.answer: Drusilla La Salle must protect her standing at Northshire Abbey. Entering the library's secured archives would alert the clerics and paladins. When a novice stole the tome and joined the Defias, she had a chance to acquire it through an apprentice.

faq.q: Where is the stolen tome hidden?
faq.answer: The Defias hid the tome in a tent at their campsite in the Northshire Vineyards, east of the abbey.

faq.q: Why did a Northshire novice join the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Discontent and strife across the kingdom drive laborers, farmers, and church students to join the Defias Brotherhood. The novice abandoned his vows, stole several important books from the library, then fled to the vineyard bandits.

faq.q: What reward does a warlock get for retrieving the tome?
faq.answer: Returning the tome proves you have the nerve and resilience to practice the dark arts. Drusilla rewards you with the teachings to summon an imp, your first demon.

faq.q: Do the Defias know how to use the book?
faq.answer: The bandits treat the stolen books as valuable plunder from the abbey. Though the Defias employ renegade spellcasters, the novice and his comrades tucked the tome into a tent crate instead of mastering its dark secrets.

angles.text: As a warlock, you prove you can cross dangerous ground without flinching. Securing the tome earns you the rites to call your first imp.
As a human, you see the Defias Brotherhood's reach in Northshire, where even abbey students steal sacred texts and join the insurrection.
As an Alliance member, you tread softly around Northshire's paladins and clerics, using outlaws' mistakes to claim restricted occult knowledge.
